respond to criticism: The singer chose to respond to criticism calmly, thanking fans online for their honest opinions.
那位歌手選擇冷靜地回應批評，在網路上感謝粉絲們誠實的意見。
respond to treatment: The doctor said the patient is responding to treatment well and may leave the hospital next week.
醫生說病人對治療有反應而且狀況良好，下週可能就能出院。
respond with anger: When his brother broke his new phone, Tom responded with anger and refused to speak to him for days.
弟弟弄壞了他的新手機，湯姆憤怒回應，好幾天都不肯跟他說話。
respond to a call: Firefighters must respond to a call within minutes, no matter what time of day or night it is.
消防員無論白天或深夜，都必須在幾分鐘內回應呼叫。
respond positively: We hope most students will respond positively to the new lunch menu, which is healthier and tastier.
我們希望大多數學生會對更健康、更美味的新午餐菜單正面回應。
rest on one's laurels: After winning the contest last year, she did not rest on her laurels and kept practicing every day.
去年贏得比賽後，她並沒有安於現狀，仍然每天持續練習。
rest the case: The lawyer showed the last video to the judge and then decided to rest the case, confident that the jury would agree.
律師把最後一段影片給法官看之後決定結束陳述，深信陪審團會認同。
the decision rests with: Teachers can give advice, but the final decision rests with the students and their parents.
老師可以給建議，但最終的決定權在學生和他們的家長。
rest on the assumption: The whole plan rests on the assumption that the weather will be good on the day of the concert.
整個計畫建立在演唱會當天天氣會很好的假設上。
lay to rest: The new report finally laid to rest the rumors that the factory was going to close.
新的報告終於平息了工廠即將關閉的謠言。
restore order: The police were sent to restore order after the fans started fighting outside the stadium.
球迷在體育場外開始打架後，警方被派去恢復秩序。
restore confidence: The coach's kind words helped restore confidence in the young players after their terrible loss.
慘敗之後，教練溫暖的話語幫助年輕球員恢復信心。
restore a painting: Experts spent two years repairing the cracks and colors to restore a painting badly damaged in the fire.
專家花了兩年修補裂痕和色彩，修復一幅在火災中嚴重受損的畫作。
restore power: After the typhoon, workers climbed the poles all night to restore power to thousands of homes.
颱風過後，工人們整夜爬上電線桿，為數千戶人家恢復供電。
restore peace: The United Nations sent soldiers to the area to restore peace after years of war.
經過多年戰爭後，聯合國派遣士兵到該地區恢復和平。
restore someone to health: The fresh mountain air and good food slowly restored him to health after his long illness.
久病之後，清新的山間空氣和營養的食物使他慢慢恢復健康。
restrain oneself: He wanted to shout at the rude customer, but he tried hard to restrain himself and answer politely.
他很想對那位無禮的客人大吼，但他努力克制自己，禮貌地回答。
restrain one's anger: Although the referee made an unfair call, the player restrained his anger and walked quietly back to his position.
雖然裁判做出不公平的判決，那位球員按捺怒氣，安靜地走回自己的位置。
restrain a prisoner: Two guards had to restrain a prisoner who suddenly began attacking other people in the dining hall.
兩名警衛必須制伏一名突然在餐廳攻擊他人的囚犯。
restrain spending: The government plans to restrain spending this year because it has borrowed too much money.
政府計畫今年控制開支，因為它已經借了太多錢。
restrain growth: High interest rates may restrain growth in the housing market for the next few years.
高利率可能會在未來幾年抑制房市的成長。
restrict access: The school will restrict access to the library during exam week, so only seniors can enter.
學校在考試週會限制進入圖書館，只有高三生可以進去。
restrict freedom: Some parents worry that too many rules will restrict freedom and stop children from thinking for themselves.
有些家長擔心太多規定會限制自由，讓孩子無法獨立思考。
restrict oneself to: To sleep better, try to restrict yourself to one cup of coffee a day, and never drink it after lunch.
為了睡得更好，試著只限於每天喝一杯咖啡，而且午餐後絕對不要喝。
restrict imports: The country decided to restrict imports of foreign rice in order to protect local farmers.
該國決定限制外國稻米進口，以保護本地農民。
restricted area: Visitors are not allowed to enter the restricted area near the army base without special permission.
沒有特別許可，訪客不得進入軍事基地附近的管制區。
resume work: After a short lunch break, the workers resumed work on the new bridge across the river.
短暫的午休後，工人們復工，繼續建造跨河的新橋。
resume talks: The two companies agreed to resume talks next month after failing to reach a deal in May.
兩家公司在五月未能達成協議後，同意下個月恢復談判。
resume one's seat: After giving his speech, the student bowed to the audience and resumed his seat in the front row.
演講結束後，那名學生向觀眾鞠躬，然後回到前排的座位。
resume normal service: The MRT company said trains would resume normal service by noon after the power problem was fixed.
捷運公司表示，電力問題修復後，列車將在中午前恢復正常服務。
